yamami.viz

Visualization module for YAMAMI.

Provides color-coded DOY (Day of Year) visualizations for phenology and snowmelt data.

yamami.viz.viz(data, colormap='viridis', vmin=None, vmax=None, output_dir=None)[source]

Generate color-coded DOY visualizations.

Creates matplotlib figures with colorbar/legend for phenology or snowmelt data. For phenology data (gup, gdown, gmax), generates three maps. For snowmelt data (doy), generates a single doy_map.

Parameters:

  • data (DataFrame | dict) – Input data as DataFrame or dict. For DataFrame: columns ‘row’, ‘col’, and data columns (gup, gdown, gmax for phenology; doy for snowmelt). For dict: keys are data names, values are 2D numpy arrays.

  • colormap (str) – Matplotlib colormap name (default: “viridis”)

  • vmin (int | None) – Minimum value for colormap normalization

  • vmax (int | None) – Maximum value for colormap normalization

  • output_dir (str | None) – Directory to save PNG files. If None, returns arrays.

Returns:

If output_dir is provided, returns dict of file paths.

Otherwise, returns dict of numpy arrays (RGBA images).

Return type:

dict

Example

>>> data = pd.DataFrame({
...     "row": [0, 0, 1, 1],
...     "col": [0, 1, 0, 1],
...     "gup": [100, 110, 105, 115],
...     "gdown": [250, 260, 255, 265],
...     "gmax": [175, 185, 180, 190],
... })
>>> result = viz(data, output_dir="/path/to/output")
>>> print(result.keys())
dict_keys(['gup', 'gdown', 'gmax'])
